intervals.label: collaboration: approval
intervals.locator: Greybook record for WA98 (JSON, experiment details)
intervals.note: Approval date as recorded in Greybook. Specht (2014 slides) gives 1991 for WA98 (conflict; Greybook, the official registry, is used). The Greybook status-history rows start in 1983 (they carry the earlier WA80-era dates) and are not used. The interval ends when lead-beam data taking began (1994).

intervals.label: collaboration: data taking (Pb beam)
intervals.note: Year precision. The WA98 paper and the 2026 review both state lead-beam data in 1994, 1995 and 1996.
intervals.quote: The experiment took data with the 158·A GeV 208 Pb beams from the SPS in 1994, 1995, and 1996.

intervals.label: collaboration: completed
intervals.locator: arXiv:nucl-ex/0108006, Section 2 ('final WA98 run period in 1996')
intervals.note: Year precision: 1996 was the final WA98 run period. The Goliath magnet then moved from the West to the North Area for NA57.
